messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

message.content:
The “best” month really depends on what you’re looking for—weather, crowd levels, or price—but most travelers find that late spring (April–May) and early fall (September–October) strike the best balance:

| Season | Typical Weather | Crowds | Price |
|--------|-----------------|--------|-------|
| **Late Spring (Apr‑May)** | Warm, sunny days; sea temps around 78–82 °F (26–28 °C). | Moderate – still before the summer rush. | Mid‑range – cheaper than peak summer. |
| **Summer (Jun‑Aug)** | Hot, dry, very sunny; sea temps 83–86 °F (28–30 °C). | High – school holidays, big crowds. | Peak pricing. |
| **Early Fall (Sep‑Oct)** | Warm, pleasant; sea temps 81–84 °F (27–29 °C). | Low – post‑summer lull. | Lower than summer, still good deals. |
| **Winter (Dec‑Feb)** | Cooler, especially in windward areas; sea temps 73–77 °F (23–25 °C). | Low – off‑season. | Lowest rates, but some showers and cooler winds. |

If you want the warmest, driest conditions and don’t mind crowds and higher costs, July–August works. If you prefer fewer tourists and slightly cooler seas, consider September or October. For the best overall mix of comfortable weather, reasonable crowds, and moderate prices, aim for late April through early May or September through early October.
